## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/ exists with a known detected_by distribution

Create the fixture directory tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/ and inside it a single consolidated JSON array file sample-bugs.json containing 7+ synthetic bug records with a known detected_by distribution: 3 records with tag 'detected_by:tests', 2 with 'detected_by:review-llm', 1 with 'detected_by:review-human', 1 with 'detected_by:production'. Each record must match the full ticket CLI output schema (ticket_id, ticket_type:'bug', title, status, author, created_at, env_id, parent_id, priority, assignee, alias, description, tags array, comments, deps, bridge_alerts, reverts, file_impact, preconditions_summary), mirroring the precedent set by tests/fixtures/818-corpus/sample-bugs.json. The fixture is consumed by downstream calibration tooling (story cc87) — schema fidelity matters.

Also create the RED test tests/scripts/test-a34c-fixture-distribution.sh that loads sample-bugs.json, asserts the file exists, parses as a JSON array with >=7 entries, and verifies the detected_by tag distribution matches the documented counts (3/2/1/1). Use jq for JSON parsing — assert on counts, not grep on raw file.

## Testing Mode
RED — write the distribution test first; it fails because sample-bugs.json does not exist. Then create the fixture to make it pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Fixture file exists at tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/sample-bugs.json — Verify: test -f tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/sample-bugs.json
- Fixture parses as a JSON array with at least 7 elements — Verify: jq -e 'type == "array" and length >= 7' tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/sample-bugs.json
- Fixture detected_by distribution matches documented counts (3 tests, 2 review-llm, 1 review-human, 1 production) — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-a34c-fixture-distribution.sh
- Every fixture record carries exactly one detected_by:<channel> tag from the seven allowed values — Verify: jq -e 'all(.[]; (.tags | map(select(startswith("detected_by:"))) | length) == 1 and (.tags | map(select(test("^detected_by:(tests|review-llm|review-human|production|user-report|internal-dogfood|other)$"))) | length) == 1)' tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/sample-bugs.json
- Each fixture record contains required ticket CLI schema fields — Verify: jq -e 'all(.[]; has("ticket_id") and has("ticket_type") and has("title") and has("status") and has("tags") and has("comments") and has("deps") and has("preconditions_summary"))' tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/sample-bugs.json
- RED test file is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-a34c-fixture-distribution.sh

## File Impact
- tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/sample-bugs.json — Create
- tests/scripts/test-a34c-fixture-distribution.sh — Create
